newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's PDVSA to discuss joining units - report.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's PDVSA to discuss joining units - report.

text.p: Top officials from Venezuelan state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) will meet July 10 to 12 to discuss plans to reorganize the holding company and possibly unify its affiliates, local daily El Nacional reported.
According to the El Nacional report the re-organization seeks to find synergies, reduce costs and avoid competition between the three main affiliates Corpoven, Maraven and Lagoven.
"What we have to discuss is whether it is really necessary to have three companies carrying out exploration and production, or if it is necessary to unify them," a PDVSA source told the paper.
